claim: Vision-weight placement on Strix Halo; exact outputs vs resident, capacity benefit, no decode speed claim.

protocol.model: fresh daemon each arm; max_seq4096, MTP/DFlash off, greedy seed1234, closed thinking prefix, eager HIP
protocol.requests: A first, A twice warm, B, repeated A, text-only seasons query
protocol.metric: Median of three per-process medians over the two warm A requests plus repeated A; client send-to-first token/reasoning bytes includes image work.
protocol.generator_prefill_ms: Existing native counter starts after vision; retained only as a separate internal metric.
protocol.token_audit: HIPFIRE_EMIT_TOKEN_IDS=1 on every arm; commit_ready -> matching commit -> identical done is checked.
protocol.memory: Device-global sysfs VRAM while physical leases held, after identical requests; process RSS separately. UMA counters overlap; no summing.
